query:
SELECT 
  state_code,
  status,
  candidate1_name,
  candidate2_name,
  primary_winner,
  called_winner,
  primary_party,
  pct_reporting
FROM senate_races
WHERE state_code IN ('NJ', 'IA', 'SD', 'NM', 'MT')
ORDER BY state_code;
